titles.en: Carpet area units: square feet and square yards
titles.zh: 地毯面积单位：平方英尺与平方码
titles.fr: Unités de surface des moquettes : pieds et yards carrés
titles.es: Unidades de superficie de alfombras: pies y yardas cuadradas

summaries.en: A square yard contains nine square feet by definition. This conversion concerns area only; roll length, usable width, cutting layout and waste require separate calculation.
summaries.zh: 按单位定义，1 平方码等于 9 平方英尺。此换算只涉及面积；卷材长度、有效幅宽、裁切布局和损耗须另行计算。
summaries.fr: Par définition, un yard carré équivaut à neuf pieds carrés. Cette conversion concerne uniquement la surface ; la longueur du rouleau, la largeur utile, le plan de coupe et les pertes se calculent séparément.
summaries.es: Por definición, una yarda cuadrada equivale a nueve pies cuadrados. La conversión solo se refiere al área; la longitud del rollo, el ancho útil, el plan de corte y los desperdicios se calculan por separado.

sources.publisher: NIST Handbook 44 (2025), Appendix C — Units of Area
sources.notes: Primary source independently located: 1 square yard = 9 square feet. Reference for independently authored facts only; publication reuse rights not approved.
Corroborates 1 ft² = 0.09290304 m² and 1 yd² = 0.8361274 m²; do not reproduce source tables.

titles.en: Carpet roll width and cut planning
titles.fr: Largeur des rouleaux de moquette et planification des découpes
titles.es: Ancho de los rollos de alfombra y planificación de cortes

summaries.en: Cut planning should use the actual usable roll width and measured installation dimensions. Seam placement, pile direction, pattern matching and product instructions may affect the layout. No universal roll width or waste percentage is assumed.
summaries.zh: 裁切规划应依据实际可用卷宽及测量得到的安装尺寸。接缝位置、绒毛方向、花纹对齐及产品安装说明都可能影响布局。不预设统一卷宽或通用损耗百分比。
summaries.fr: Le plan de coupe doit utiliser la largeur réellement utilisable du rouleau et les dimensions mesurées. Les joints, le sens du velours, les raccords de motifs et les instructions du fabricant peuvent modifier le plan. Aucune largeur ni aucun taux de perte universels ne sont présumés.
summaries.es: La planificación de cortes debe utilizar el ancho útil real del rollo y las dimensiones medidas. Las uniones, la dirección del pelo, la coincidencia de patrones y las instrucciones del fabricante pueden modificar el diseño. No se presupone un ancho ni un porcentaje de desperdicio universal.

sources.publisher: The Carpet and Rug Institute — CRI 105 Residential Carpet Installation Standard
sources.notes: Verified sections 5.1–5.3: seam planning, matching pile direction for adjacent pieces, cutting to seam diagram, minimum 3-inch trimming allowance along each wall and sufficient pattern-matching material where applicable. Residential standard; not a universal cut optimizer rule. Copyrighted reference; do not reproduce.

sources.publisher: The Carpet and Rug Institute — CRI 104 Commercial Carpet Installation Standard
sources.notes: Verified sections 18.3–18.6: patterned carpet seam diagrams, roll sequence, extra material for pattern match and alignment. Commercial context; do not apply residential trim allowances universally.
Official index identifies CRI 104 (commercial) and CRI 105 (residential), and links English and Spanish versions. Linking is not permission to reproduce standards.

titles.en: Carpet seams, pile direction and pattern alignment
titles.zh: 地毯接缝、绒毛方向与花纹对齐
titles.fr: Joints de moquette, sens du velours et raccords de motifs
titles.es: Uniones de alfombras, dirección del pelo y alineación de patrones

summaries.en: Seam layout, pile direction and pattern alignment can affect a carpet installation plan. Appropriate requirements depend on the specific product, installation method and applicable manufacturer instructions. This draft does not prescribe a universal seam location or installation technique.
summaries.zh: 接缝布局、绒毛方向和花纹对齐可能影响地毯安装规划。具体要求取决于产品、安装方法和适用的厂家说明。本草稿不规定通用接缝位置或施工方法。
summaries.fr: L'emplacement des joints, le sens du velours et les raccords de motifs peuvent influencer le plan de pose d'une moquette. Les exigences dépendent du produit, de la méthode de pose et des instructions applicables du fabricant. Ce brouillon ne prescrit aucune position de joint ni technique universelle.
summaries.es: La disposición de las uniones, la dirección del pelo y la alineación de patrones pueden influir en la instalación de una alfombra. Los requisitos dependen del producto, del método de instalación y de las instrucciones aplicables del fabricante. Este borrador no prescribe ubicaciones de unión ni técnicas universales.

sources.publisher: The Carpet and Rug Institute — CRI 105 Residential Carpet Installation Standard
sources.notes: CRI 105 residential, section 16.3–16.5: patterned carpet seam diagram should reflect pattern direction; sequencing and additional material for pattern match. Independently checked against standard. No general-purpose seam location prescribed.

sources.publisher: The Carpet and Rug Institute — CRI 104 Commercial Carpet Installation Standard
sources.notes: CRI 104 commercial, sections 18.3–18.6: seam diagram, pattern/roll sequence and alignment. Independently checked against standard; manufacturer instructions and installation type remain product-specific.
Official CRI landing page confirms CRI 104 commercial / CRI 105 residential distinction; publicly viewable standards are not a reuse license.
